2.en: As characters weave through the ongoing Strifes of the Heresies Macharia, a number of major plotlines continue to build and progress in the background. As GM, you should be aware of and keep track of these elements and their potential repercussions.

10.en: Gathering the Inquisitors of the sector together is no trifling matter, and @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.CbYL1IrXodXyGuyV]{Sylvestrine Horst} knows this; the other Inquisitors could consider her a troubling upstart or see through her plans from the get-go, and the consequences could conceivably end in violence. But she has been planning the Macharian Conclaves for a long time and finally believes it is worth the risk to put them into action.

14.en: Primarily, @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.CbYL1IrXodXyGuyV]{Horst} intends to gain the favour of her fellow Inquisitors to either reach the position of Inquisitor Lord herself or elevate someone she judges worthy of the position (or someone she can manipulate). Either way, this would improve her authority in the sector and open doors for her to achieve her other goals.

18.en: Secondarily, @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.CbYL1IrXodXyGuyV]{Horst} desires to know what led to the death of her former master, Inquisitor Lord Hieronymo Drake, on the planet @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.lpu6iuTHw50UavbI]{Belnshudha}. Horst already investigated @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.X5EFP7IgIUx6CaBW#battle-group-fortis]{Battle Group Fortis} to exhaustion, and those ordered to enact

22.en: upon the planet found little to pursue. But her investigation is a cover for her misdeeds and the actual actions that led to her ascension. Now she is cleaning up her former master’s messes, hearing utterances of the ‘Kryptman Protocol’ loosely tied to Drake’s previous activities that she wishes to thoroughly investigate in secret.

30.en: The truth is this: Hieronymo Drake spent the latter years of his life seeding a network of loyal acolytes and sleeper agents throughout various institutions across the sector, including the @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.6hX0E9XlPUoRaDaQ.JournalEntryPage.6Yav4onpokz5e5jg]{Astra Militarum} and @UUID[unknown]{Navis Imperialis}. These agents are charged with a singular task: upon receipt of a code phrase known only to Drake, hidden hypno-indoctrinated orders within their minds are revealed, compelling them to action. By utilising the resources and authority they had accumulated, they are to use the Imperium’s arsenals to ravage numerous worlds along the border of the Macharian Sector and render them lifeless. Each agent knew only of their specific task, which was often hidden in the depths of their mind.

34.en: None save Drake knew of the scale of destruction this secretive cabal would unleash.

38.en: The Kryptman protocol intends to create a cordon of lifeless worlds, a firebreak to prevent Leviathan from feeding on the sector’s biomass. This stalls the inevitable invasion and buys time until the Imperium can find a better solution. But even Drake lacked the will to use this weapon before the Hive Fleet’s arrival, knowing the sacrifice of billions of lives and countless productive worlds would alter the Macharian Sector for centuries.

42.en: He considered it entirely possible that, in saving the heart of the sector, he would condemn it to a conflagration of civil strife and privation to equal that of the Macharian Heresy. He kept all this a secret from the rest of the Inquisition, partially out of fear that his work would become undone and because Drake feared that the High Lords of Terra would find out and force his hand and sacrifice the Macharian Sector to protect Segmentum Solar.

50.en: Inquisitor @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Eskender Thracius} of the @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.brh2O5CexxurRbM7.JournalEntryPage.YFKg8L1rfWbScqkr#ordo-xenos]{Ordo Xenos} treads on thin ice. He has avoided contact with the rest of the Inquisition for decades to further his @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.brh2O5CexxurRbM7.JournalEntryPage.UAWh0hEvWDwob6CT]{Isstvanist} goals without any of his peers getting in the way, but he knows that Inquisitor @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Konstan Serranus}, a Puritan member of the Ordo Xenos, is on his tail, Serranus knows that Thracius has consorted with the @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#aeldari]{Aeldari} and that alone is enough for Serranus to think of him a traitor.

54.en: However, @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Thracius} is a self-aware adherent of Radical @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.brh2O5CexxurRbM7.JournalEntryPage.UAWh0hEvWDwob6CT]{Isstvanist} philosophy; he knows that many see his actions as heretical and that their interference is expected, so Thracius has spent decades preparing for a personal shadow campaign to continue his efforts hidden from the Inquisition’s oversight. Primarily, he has established numerous false identities, some amongst the Inquisition itself, employing psychic powers and the potent shape-changing chemical polymorphine to shroud his true identity.

58.en: As the Macharian Inquisition is called to Conclave, the time has come for him to fake his death and disappear into the background, allowing his carefully constructed aliases to thrive and effectively take his place. Furthermore, @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Thracius} does not trust @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.CbYL1IrXodXyGuyV]{Horst's} intentions at face value. He even suspects the former Interrogator of having plotted against her master. After all, too many Inquisitors fall afoul of assassination by their own Interrogator.

62.en: Was there even a Noctilith Gate on @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.lpu6iuTHw50UavbI]{Belnshudha} to begin with? Furthermore, @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Thracius} knows enough about the Kryptman Protocol to piece together some version of the truth — might @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.CbYL1IrXodXyGuyV]{Horst} be an Agent of the High Lords of Terra tasked with intentionally sacrificing the sector?

66.en: At the very least, @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Thracius} knows that these Conclaves might rattle the cages of the Macharian Inquisition and may compromise his identity. Thankfully, he still has a seat at the table under the guise of Inquisitor

70.en: . An @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.brh2O5CexxurRbM7.JournalEntryPage.YFKg8L1rfWbScqkr#ordo-xenos]{Ordo Xenos} Inquisitor who rose from the ashes of the @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.dOdB17RuClYozQ15]{Noctis Aeterna}, a hero of the Imperium that repelled xenos invasions through the years of blinding, has become well-established within the Macharian Sector. Impersonating another Inquisitor is an incredibly fraught prospect, but Thracius has the advantage of being one. His only means of survival may be to nudge the Inquisition, as a whole, carefully in the right direction or even go as far as claiming the title of Inquisitor Lord for himself.

78.en: For generations, the @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#tyranids]{Genestealer Cults} of the Macharian Sector have been slowly infecting its worlds, seeding their tainted lineage among the people and patiently awaiting the inevitable arrival of their star-borne saviours. But many within the cults are not content to wait for their day of ascension; they intend to hasten the fated arrival of the Tyranid Hive Mind and have concocted a horrifying plan that spans multiple worlds, one the Inquisition must act upon or risk losing the entire sector.

82.en: The unintelligible minds of the Patriarch alliance have instructed their cults to abduct Human psykers, conjoining them into a horrifying union of chitin and soft encephalic flesh, thrumming with psychic energy. A grotesque mass of neural matter capable of projecting a monumental psychic wail. The Maguses’ have dubbed this the Herald’s Howl, intended as an unignorable signal to summon their longed-for star gods, a beacon screaming, ‘

84.en: Come to us! We have found worlds ripe for your enlightenment!

90.en: Whether this gruesome plot will achieve its intended goal is impossible to tell. If the Herald’s Howl succeeds, they might accelerate the arrival of Hive Fleet Leviathan in the Macharian Sector, hastening it by generations. Even if the profane ritual fails, Inquisitors of the @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.brh2O5CexxurRbM7.JournalEntryPage.YFKg8L1rfWbScqkr#ordo-malleus]{Ordo Malleus} suspect that such a massive gathering of psychic potential may provide an open door to daemonkind — thereby trading a xenos threat for a grand-scale daemonic incursion.

94.en: Ultimately, the characters and their Patron's actions will decide how the Herald's Howl resolves. Some of the most likely outcomes are thus:

102.en: They might seek to destroy the Herald’s Howl before it can draw the attention of the Hive Fleet.

110.en: A Radical group might seek to nullify the Howl somehow but preserve it for study.

118.en: They might fail to deal with the Howl entirely, forcing them to enact the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-kryptman-protocol]{Kryptman Protocol}.

126.en: They might let the Herald’s Howl come to fruition, luring a tendril of Leviathan away from Holy Terra. A group which has uncovered the Kryptman Protocol might seek to use Drake’s hidden network to combat the Tyranids when they arrive.

138.en: In serving the goals of the Conclave, each Inquisitor’s actions in the field further their legitimacy as a successor to Inquisitor Lord Drake. This is not an election between the sector’s Inquisitors but rather an ascension to a higher position based on their actions and presence of power. Throughout the Heresies Macharia, each Inquisitor is given a Legitimacy score to track the development of an Inquisitor’s worthiness.

146.en: This score starts at zero for each Inquisitor.

154.en: An Inquisitor’s Legitimacy score should not be shared directly with the players.

162.en: If they wish to find out which Inquisitors are in the running, they can investigate during a Conclave (similar to gauging their Subtlety) to see who is ahead.

170.en: Each Strife’s Outcome includes a Legitimacy increase for the characters’ Patron (or the Inquisitor their Patron serves) if they successfully resolve the Strife. If they do not work to resolve the Strife, another Inquisitor will take the opportunity to do so, with the Outcome section indicating which Inquisitor increases their Legitimacy instead.

174.en: At the @UUID[.AYJ70cmnV5Y6rDDt]{final Conclave}, the Inquisitor with the highest Legitimacy score has demonstrated that they alone exhibit the capacity to hold rank and respect as Inquisitor Lord. By taking the boldest actions, they will have shown the will to act where others would hesitate, the pragmatism to know what must be excised for the survival of the Imperium as a whole, and the wisdom contained in their own philosophy as a means to enact the God-Emperor’s will. However, note that this position will not free an Inquisitor from rivalry; their opponents may continue to work against them in the shadows.
